question: Mukhyamantri Bagayat Vikas Mission (Horticulture Development Mission) scheme was launched by which of the following state governments in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mukhyamantri Bagayat Vikas Mission(Horticulture Development Mission)**__

 __
 
• Mukhyamantri Bagayat Vikas Mission is also known as Horticulture Development Mission.
 
• It was launched by former Chief Minister Vijay Rupani.
 
• This scheme has been launched with the objective of doubling the farmer's income who are engaged in horticulture and medicinal farming.
 
• Under it, the wasteland of the government of Gujarat will provide a thirty-year lease for the purpose of farming the medicinal and horticulture crops.
 
• It has fixed the leaseholders will not be allowed to sell the instalments.
 
• The mission will allow growing only fruits and medicinal plants. It will not allow farmers to grow cash crops and grains.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Gujarat**__

 
 
• Capital: Gandhinagar
 
• Chief Minister: Bhupendrabhai Patel (July 2021)
 
• Governor: Acharya Devrat
 
• State bird: Greater Flamingo
 
• State animal: Asiatic Lion
 
• State flower: Marigold
 
• National Parks: Vansda National Park, Blackbuck National Park, Gir National Park, Marine National Park.
